newsitem.title: USA: US Plains cattle sales slow after brisk $64 -trade.
newsitem.headline: US Plains cattle sales slow after brisk $64 -trade.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle sales at $64.00 per cwt turned slow near midday Tuesday following brisk trading early, feedlot sources said.
About 40,000 head sold in Kansas and about 40,000 in the Texas Panhandle and western Oklahoma area, they said.
The sales were steady with light trade on Monday, but down $1.00 from late last week and down $2.00 from last week's top.
Activity slowed when some packer buyers backed their bids down to $63.00, several cattle feeders said.
Fed cattle prices were pressured by a large supply of market-ready cattle and a slowdown in beef demand.
